description: Vessel Arrivals (>75 GT) Breakdown, Monthly is a dataset listed in Singapore open data portal (data.gov.sg), an open data portal, published or maintained by Maritime and Port Authority of Singapore. Dataset shows the monthly number of vessel arrivals (75 GT) and shipping tonnage by type. Only vessels that are more than 75 Gross Tonnes are included. (Latest month figures are preliminary estimates. ). Coverage: Singapore. The portal files it under the publisher Maritime and Port Authority of Singapore. It offers 1 resource(s) in csv. The portal shows 2026-09-16 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support port and shipping studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-sg-dgs-portal.
